name: @yottameta/yotta-chart
description: YuanTu (元图) — a universal result-presentation layer for AI agents: turn any AI output (JSON / Markdown / plain text) into a standard content object, pick a presentation form (conclusion card / table / checklist / prose / metric board / QA card / report / chart), and render copyable Markdown + plain text with optional local SVG. Local offline (Python 3.8+ standard library); 12-chart SVG kernel; MCP server with present_result tool; not a chart tool.
